name: Proptech and real estate
metaTitle: Proptech and Real Estate Software Development
description: Techlio builds resident platforms, smart-building software, automated leasing and investor-facing platforms for property technology companies and real estate firms.
h1: Software and AI for property technology, *built around the building.*
answer: Techlio engineers software for proptech companies and real estate firms: resident apps, access control and smart-device platforms, AI-assisted leasing, and investor-facing sites with automated workflows. For OneQuext we merged three property-tech products into one platform with zero downtime, and for Madera Equity we built the firm's digital platform from discovery to support.
problems: Several products bought or built over time that residents and staff experience as separate systems
Access control, smart devices and Wi-Fi that each come with their own app and data
Leasing and enquiry work that depends on staff being available to answer
Investor and market information kept in documents instead of a platform the team can update

faqs.question: Can you merge existing products without taking them offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. On OneQuext we consolidated three existing products into one platform with zero downtime. The approach depends on the systems involved, so we start with an architecture review before committing to a migration plan.

faqs.question: Do you work with hardware such as locks and intercoms?
faqs.answer: We build the software side: the platform, mobile apps and integrations that talk to access control, smart devices and video intercom. The OneQuext platform manages all of these. We do not manufacture or install hardware.

faqs.question: Can AI handle leasing enquiries?
faqs.answer: It can handle the repeatable part: answering common questions, qualifying an enquiry and booking a viewing, with a hand-off to staff for anything unusual. Automated leasing is part of the OneQuext platform.
